app.name: Masar
app.tagline: Every lead has a follow-up. Every follow-up has a time.

auth.description: Keep real estate follow-up organized, from first contact through close.
auth.sendLink: We will send you a confirmation link to finish signing up.
auth.supabaseMissing: Add Supabase credentials to your environment to enable sign-in.

organization.setupDescription: Set up your sales workspace and local business hours.
organization.name: Organization name
organization.webhookDescription: Connect a form or campaign. Every lead is assigned and given a follow-up task automatically.
organization.webhookError: Could not create the secret. Check your organization role.
organization.webhookRevealOnce: Copy this secret and store it now. It will not be shown again.
organization.webhookBody: Send a JSON POST with name and phone. email, source, and property_interest are optional.
organization.webhookRotationWarning: Rotating the secret immediately invalidates the previous one.
organization.workflowDescription: One focused rule: balanced assignment, a required follow-up, then reminder and escalation.
organization.autoAssignHelp: During working hours, leads rotate across active sales members, starting with the longest-waiting member.
organization.noSalesMembers: There are no sales members in this organization yet.
organization.noActiveSales: Leads stay with the manager until a salesperson is active; their follow-up remains scheduled.
organization.workingMinutesHelp: Deadlines count organization working hours and days only.
organization.impactAssumptionsDescription: Set an average deal value in {currency} and your expected close rate. These estimates are used only to calculate potential revenue protected.
organization.impactAssumptionsError: Enter a positive average deal value and a close rate from 0 to 100%.

dashboard.leadNameRequired: Enter a lead name of at least 2 characters.
dashboard.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Egypt or Saudi phone number.
dashboard.leadFormError: The lead could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
dashboard.leadFormAuthError: Your session expired. Sign in again to add this lead.
dashboard.todayTasksDescription: Leads and follow-ups sorted by due time and urgency.
dashboard.todayEmptyDescription: New leads waiting for contact appear in the WhatsApp queue.
dashboard.whatsappQueueDescription: New leads waiting for a first contact.
dashboard.whatsappQueueEmptyDescription: New leads will appear here as soon as they arrive.
dashboard.outcomeSaveError: Contact was not saved. Check your connection and retry.
dashboard.taskUndoError: The follow-up could not be reopened. Refresh and try again.
dashboard.taskSaveError: Follow-up was not saved. Retry when connected.
dashboard.syncUnavailable: Connect to sync before saving this change.
dashboard.savedOffline: Saved on this device. It will sync when connected.
dashboard.syncFailed: Some changes could not sync. They remain saved on this device.
dashboard.whatsappOutcomeHint: Open WhatsApp, send your message there, then return and log the contact.
dashboard.pushDenied: Notification permission is blocked in your browser.
dashboard.pushUnsupported: Browser notifications are not supported here.
dashboard.managerDescription: First response, service levels, and current pipeline health.
dashboard.impactReportDescription: A lead counts once when its first response follows the latest reminder or escalation.
dashboard.baselineCollecting: The baseline is captured automatically after the first 7 days, once each lead has had a full 24-hour response window.
dashboard.revenueEstimateDisclaimer: Protected revenue is an estimate based on the owner's average deal value and close rate, not booked revenue.
dashboard.metricsUnavailable: Manager metrics are temporarily unavailable. Refresh the page or try again later.
dashboard.responseTrend: Minutes from lead creation to first response
dashboard.noResponseData: No first responses in this range
dashboard.noResponseDataDescription: First-response averages appear after a lead moves out of New.
dashboard.leadsPastSlaDescription: Open leads with an overdue follow-up and no later activity
dashboard.noLeadsPastSlaDescription: Open leads are within their follow-up window.
dashboard.overdueBySalespersonDescription: Open follow-ups past their due time
dashboard.noOverdueTasksDescription: Every salesperson is up to date.
dashboard.funnelDescription: Leads created in the selected period
dashboard.noFunnelLeadsDescription: Try a wider date range or different filters.
dashboard.importDescription: Upload a CSV or Excel file, review the column mapping, then import valid rows.
dashboard.importFileLabel: CSV or XLSX file, up to 5 MB and 500 rows
dashboard.importResult: Added {created}, skipped {duplicates} duplicates, and could not import {failed}.
dashboard.importForbidden: Only organization managers and owners can import lists.
dashboard.importFileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
dashboard.importUnsupportedFile: Supported formats are CSV and XLSX.
dashboard.importEmptyFile: No header and data rows were found in the file.
dashboard.importTooManyRows: Imports are limited to 500 rows at a time.
dashboard.importInvalidFile: We could not read this file. Check its format and try again.
dashboard.importFailed: The import could not be completed. Try again.
dashboard.duplicateLead: This phone number is already on file. No second copy was added.
dashboard.emptyLeadsDescription: Add the lead details and we’ll assign an owner and set a follow-up time.
dashboard.emptyTasksDescription: Every new lead gets a follow-up time automatically.
dashboard.reminderEmpty: Nothing needs your attention right now.
